parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs indicated for multiple myeloma. Filter molecule_dictionary to max_phase = 4. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures via INNER JOIN on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter drug_indication where mesh_heading or efo_term contains 'multiple myeloma'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id aliased as indication_curie, efo_term aliased as indication_label, max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
